findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler but defines no methods with just `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler has abstract members counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values and build_occurrence_and_event_data, so the subclass remains abstract. Detector.detector_handler does `group_type.detector_handler(self)` which will raise TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class, breaking any processing of metric_alert detectors.

findings.title: get_state_data KeyErrors when counter_names is empty
findings.body: counter_updates dict is only populated inside `if self.counter_names:`. The result loop unconditionally does `counter_updates=counter_updates[gk]`. A detector with no counters (counter_names == []) will therefore raise KeyError for every group key instead of returning empty counter dicts.

findings.title: Redis key builders conflate None and empty-string group keys
findings.body: build_dedupe_value_key and build_counter_value_key map `None` to `""` before formatting, so group_key None and group_key "" produce the identical Redis key (e.g. `123::dedupe_value`). DB state and fingerprints treat them as distinct (NULL vs empty string, fingerprint `123` vs `123:`), so dedupe/counter values for the two keys will overwrite each other.

findings.title: Missing-grouptype log loses detector type
findings.body: When no grouptype is registered, the error extra logs `"group_type": str(group_type)` where group_type is None/ falsy, so it always logs "None". The useful value is `self.type` (the slug that failed lookup, already available as detector_type), so on-call debugging loses which slug was invalid.

findings.title: Stale evaluate docstring says list
findings.body: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring still says it "returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult" after the signature was changed to return `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`. Readers will expect list semantics.

findings.title: Empty Redis pipeline still executes
findings.body: _bulk_commit_redis_state calls `pipeline.execute()` unconditionally, even when both dedupe_updates and counter_updates are empty. Every detector evaluation with no state change therefore still pays a Redis round-trip.

findings.title: Multi-group test does not verify value propagation
findings.body: test_state_results_multi_group processes group_vals {"group_1": 6, "group_2": 10} but builds the expected occurrence for group_2 with value 6, and build_mock_occurrence_and_event ignores the value argument entirely. A bug passing the wrong value to build_occurrence_and_event_data would not be caught.
